title: Synthetic monitor
description: Checks, SLOs and the monitor's own health. https://github.com/MSJawad/synthetic-monitor

panels.title: Failing
panels.description: Checks whose last probe failed, whether or not their alert has fired yet.

panels.title: Alerts firing
panels.description: Checks whose alert has been sent and whose recovery notice has not.

panels.title: Lowest error budget left
panels.description: The smallest share of error budget left among checks with an SLO. Negative once overspent.

panels.title: Check state
panels.description: Up; failing: the last probe failed, below the alert threshold; down: the alert was sent; recovering: probes succeed again, below the recovery threshold.

panels.title: SLOs
panels.description: Each check's availability over its own SLO window (or since its first probe, while its history is shorter), against its target, and how fast its error budget burned over the last hour: 1× would spend it exactly over the window. For a 30-day SLO, 14.4× over the last hour and the last 5 minutes raises an alert.

panels.title: Certificates
panels.description: Days until each TLS check's certificate chain stops verifying. Red under 14 days, the default min_days_remaining; yellow under 30.

panels.title: Heartbeats
panels.description: How long ago each heartbeat check was last pinged. Check state shows whether that is overdue.

panels.title: $timed_check
panels.description: Mean duration of the check's probes, failed ones included. Checks probed less often than once a minute show as separate points.

panels.title: $http_check
panels.description: Mean time HTTP probes spent resolving DNS, connecting, in the TLS handshake, waiting for the first byte (processing) and reading the body (transfer).

panels.title: Probes per second
panels.description: Probes completed per second, across all checks.

panels.title: Scheduler lag, 99th percentile
panels.description: How late probes start after they are due, mostly from waiting for a free slot under -max-concurrent-probes.

panels.title: Config
panels.description: Whether the last edit to the checks file was applied. A rejected file is logged, and the previous checks keep running.

panels.title: Unsent notices
panels.description: Alerts and recovery notices saved but not yet accepted by ntfy.

panels.title: Delivery failures
panels.description: Failed attempts to deliver notifications in the time range; retryable ones are retried.

panels.title: Skipped runs
panels.description: Scheduled probes skipped in the time range because the check's previous probe overran.

panels.title: Results dropped
panels.description: Results not stored or not evaluated for alerts in the time range because a queue was full.

panels.title: History write errors
panels.description: Failed writes to the SQLite history in the time range.
